_README: Hypotheses the explained-difference regression gate (scripts/identity_regression_gate.py) checks against the rows it computes at a cutover. This file describes the traded-security realignment of PLD, JCI, DD and DOW (run 2026-10-07-traded-security-realignment, change_set traded_security_realignment).

kind: filing_lineage (accessions added to or removed from a filer table, or from the filings feeding fundamentals_history_sec), market_tape (changed FTD / short-volume lines) or insider (rows leaving canonical insider history). reason: the gate reason that must explain every row of the hypothesis.
status stays `hypothesis` until the gate produces the matching rows; `expected` is the measured count (null = reported, never failed), `source` where and when it was measured.

Narrowing: table (filing_lineage, default fundamentals_history_sec); ciks (filer CIK for filing_lineage, issuer CIK for insider); cusips and tape_source (market_tape: ftd, finra or <source>_ticker_grain); dates lists ticker-grain rows a hypothesis explains by name (reason other_issuer_line).

Declared reasons (traded_security_realignment, other_issuer_line) explain only the rows their hypothesis lists: a tape line moving between two named tickers on a listed CUSIP, or a ticker-grain row on a listed date.

Removal counts were measured on the live tables while Airflow was still writing them; P8 re-measures them from its own gate snapshot (run dir _scripts/p6_hypotheses.py --snapshot) before the first write. Additions that only P8's EDGAR walk produces carry expected null.
